item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,math; from work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req,pol,expected):\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\np={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2,'unit':'cm'},{'id':'b','amount':0}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0.02,'unit':'m'},{'id':'b','amount':0,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':0,'amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':False,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'b','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'b','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':3,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'y','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'z','amount':-1}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; expected=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True)); print('boundary checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
